# CANDIDATE: SEQUENCE_AWARE_CONFLUENCE_TRIGGER

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We aim to reduce false breakdown triggers by requiring confirmation of sustained bearish momentum via a sequence of 2+ bars with decreasing highs above a broken level. This sequence-aware confluence condition should filter out whipsaws while preserving genuine breakdown moves, thereby improving edge capture on J's winner days and reducing losses on loser days.

## Mechanism

Trigger condition: When SPY breaks a defined level (premarket high, descending trendline, or prior resistance), we scan forward for a sequence of at least 2 consecutive bars where each bar's high is strictly lower than the prior bar's high. If such a sequence occurs within 5 bars of the break and remains above the broken level, we activate the confluence condition for filter 10. Entry requires this confluence signal plus at least one other trigger component (level rejection or EMA ribbon flip) per the BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup logic.
